text: Ada, Bram, and two Hunters. Fifteen tiles across. Last one standing wins.

text: Opening with a bomb to clear the crate at (3,1), then I'll retreat down the corridor.

text: Two crates in range. Exit via 13,12.

speaker: ada
text: Bram's own bomb caught him, which is a sobering way to leave. I'll keep my distance from blasts and let mine finish.

speaker: ada
text: Hunter 1 is in my corridor. I'll plant here and back out toward column 7, which should leave the bomb between us.
Hunter Two has picked up six range upgrades. And now the stones are about to start falling.

speaker: ada
text: Hunter 1 planted in its own dead end, so I'll plant below it and step sideways onto row 5 out of the blast column.

speaker: ada
text: Just Hunter 1 left, and it's coming my way. I'll plant here to guard the column and retreat onto row 5.
Ada takes the center tile. The last stone catches Hunter One right beside her. Thanks for watching The Agent Terrarium.
